subject: a description of how a small Israeli food business takes orders: when customers order, when and how they collect or get a delivery, and which products they can order

fields.prompt: how many orders the business can prepare for one hand-over slot, only if the text gives a number
up to how many hours before the slot a customer may cancel, in hours; null if the text does not say
the minimum order in whole shekels; null if not given
how long one hand-over slot is, in minutes: 30, 60 or 120 only; null if the text does not say
how many hours before the slot an order must be placed, in hours; null if the text does not say. A weekday deadline («עד חמישי») is not a number of hours: null

the weekly hand-over windows: weekday 0=Sunday … 6=Saturday, start_time and end_time HH:MM in 24 hours, fulfilment pickup or delivery. Only days the text names for collecting or delivery; a deadline for ordering is not a window. When the text gives only a part of the day use: בוקר 08:00–12:00, צהריים 12:00–16:00, אחר הצהריים 14:00–18:00, ערב 17:00–21:00
the numbers of the business's products below that the text says customers can order
